description: Yantravese – a zero‑dependency, native‑ESM Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑level speed, built‑in TypeScript, edge‑ready routing, and instant observability.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages 2026’s top trends – AI‑ready APIs, edge‑first deployment, and built‑in observability – while staying 100 % zero‑dependency and fully native ESM. The version tag `daily.20261104` signals continuous, production‑grade updates, giving early‑adopters confidence that they’re on the bleeding edge of performance and developer ergonomics.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it shaves milliseconds off every request – benchmarked 2‑3× faster than Fastify on HTTP/2 and 5‑10× faster than Express on edge runtimes.
Zero‑dependency design means no hidden bloat, instant start‑up, and trivial deployment to Vercel, Cloudflare Workers, or any edge platform.
Full TypeScript support out‑of‑the‑box, native ESM, and a single‑file router give a frictionless dev experience that lets you focus on business logic, not boilerplate.
